## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `e3be5dbbfd39bbeb5da82b0d74e126a642479082`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #36865 (body, triage 7123048376, claim 7124488286, round-1 report 7124565256, claim amendment 7124599739); PR #36919 (body, 22-file list, net diff against `origin/main`); dev report 7127125322; the 58 check-runs on the head: 45 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure. `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` (16/16), `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards` and `Dogfood Regression Gate` all passed, and those conclusions are the gate verdicts. The claim's fence (`packages/spec/**` or the server ⇒ stop) held: no spec file or server file is in the diff.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`ActionParamDef.allowCreate?: boolean` (`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`, exported from `@object-ui/core`): right.** It adds one optional member to a published interface, which is a widening: no existing producer or reader of the type breaks. The jsdoc points at `FieldSchema.allowCreate`, and on this head `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:2595` declares it (`z.boolean().optional()`). The amendment 7124599739 authorised exactly this member.
2. **`RESOLVED_ONLY_PARAM_KEYS` gains `allowCreate: fromField`: right, and the claim behind it is true on this head.** `ActionParamSchema` (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:273`) is a `strictObject`. Its top-level keys are `name, field, objectOverride, label, type, widget, required, options, placeholder, helpText, defaultValue, multiple, accept, maxSize, reference, defaultFromRow, carryOver, visible, requiresFeature`. The file has no `allowCreate` anywhere, either as an alias or as guidance, so the spec refuses an authored `allowCreate` at parse time. The dev warning (`warnResolvedOnlyKeys`, which does nothing in production) is therefore true. `resolveActionParam` never reads `param.allowCreate`: `lookupExtras` takes `field.allowCreate` only, so an authored raw value is named and ignored, the same way as its nine siblings. `RESOLVED_ONLY_PARAM_KEYS` is a public `@object-ui/fields` export (`src/index.tsx:4953`), and gaining a key widens a runtime value, which the changeset text covers. The `@object-ui/types` parity pin gains the matching `@ts-expect-error` row. Its count comment changes from "nine" to "ten", following the file's existing convention (`referenceTo` is pinned separately).
3. **`resolveActionParam` `lookupExtras` copies `allowCreate: field.allowCreate`, `RuntimeField.allowCreate?` is declared, and `paramToField` forwards `allowCreate: param.allowCreate`: right.** Undefined reaches `LookupField` as `fieldMeta.allowCreate == null`, so the picker keeps its own default (`isUserFacingReference`) for every field that declares nothing. An inline (non-field-backed) lookup param is unchanged.
4. **`toBulkParam` carries `allowCreate` under its own name (`...(resolved.allowCreate !== undefined && { allowCreate })`): right.** `BulkActionParam` (`ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts:546`) has its `[key: string]: unknown` catch-all. `bulkParamToField` spreads the rest onto the widget field, so the key reaches `LookupField` on the selection-toolbar path, which is the card's repro path. The `toBulkParam` jsdoc is updated.
5. **The LookupField quick-create re-read (`admitCreated`): right in shape. S1 below is a defect in what happens after it.**
   - *Filter.* The re-read sends `popoverFilter`, the identical object the popover's `useRecordQuery` sends as `$filter` (`useRecordQuery.ts:224`, no other filter parts). It is joined to `{ [idField]: rid }` through `mergeFilterNodes`, which makes a conjunction (each source its own child) rather than a spread, so a declared filter on the id column cannot be overwritten. This is the query shape of the recents rail, which is already in production (#5195).
   - *lookupFilters.* They go through `lookupFiltersToRecord`, with the same operator map and `orEmpty` handling as the list. Placeholder values such as `{current_user_id}` are sent as the list sends them.
   - *dependsOn scope.* `dependentFilter` is part of `popoverFilter`. The create modal is also seeded with it (`initialValues`, #35050), so a cascaded create normally passes.
   - *`$record` references.* `queryLookupFilters` is the resolved list on a record-form host. On a param dialog or bulk host (no `withRecordBeingEdited`), every `$record` entry is left out, in the list and in the re-read alike. The re-read asks exactly what the list asked. The create entry sits in the popover, which is held shut while `recordReadsPending`, so a half-resolved filter cannot be the one re-read.
   - *No filter.* `if (!popoverFilter || !dataSource || !referenceTo) return true` means no request, and the record is selected as before. The fifth row of the new pin pins this.
   - *Re-read fails.* The `catch` sets `createError` to the raw error message, `admitted` stays `false`, the picker reopens and the record is not selected. This fails closed and is never read as a pass. It is correct for the contract but unpinned and unexplained to the user (N1).
   - *Every create path is covered.* `handleCreateNew` has two call sites (the pinned footer and the empty-list entry), and both arms run through `admitCreated`: the modal `result.data` arm and the inline `dataSource.create` arm. A host-supplied `onCreateNew` bypasses it, as it bypasses `canCreate`: that affordance belongs to the host.
   - *Scope.* The change holds on every filtered lookup, record forms included, not only action params. It is not a narrowing: `FieldSchema.lookupFilters` is declared as "Base filters restricting which records are selectable", and this closes the last widget bypass of that meaning, with the same disposition as the recents rail fix. The changeset states the general scope.
6. **`lookup.createdOutsideFilters`: right.** The `FIELD_DEFAULTS` row matches `en`. The key sits under `lookup:` in all 11 packs on this head (`ar de en es fr ja ko pt-BR ru zh-Hans zh-Hant`), and the zh-Hans, ja and es values read as written by hand, not echoed.

**S1 (should-fix) — after a rejected quick-create the reopened popover cannot list or select anything for the rest of the widget's life.** In `LookupField.tsx`, `error = popoverQuery.error ?? createError`, and both the options list and the empty-list create entry render only under `!error`. `pinnedFooter` (the create button and "show all") needs `listShowsOptions`, which also needs `!error`. `setCreateError(null)` runs only at the top of `handleCreateNew`, and the error slot's Retry button calls `popoverQuery.refetch()`, which does not clear `createError`. Closing and reopening does not clear it either: there are four `setCreateError` sites, and one is the reset in `handleCreateNew`. So once `lookup.createdOutsideFilters` is shown, the popover (and the phone drawer, which shares `lookupPanelBody`) shows only that line and a Retry that does nothing. The valid candidates the PR body says the user can choose again are hidden, and the "next create attempt" the dev's out-of-scope note relies on cannot be reached, because its button is hidden too. Only the trigger-side Browse All button (classic face) gets out. On `main` the slot was reached only by a failed inline create. This PR makes a filtered-out create, the card's own scenario, the routine way into it. Fix: clear `createError` when the popover closes, or on Retry or a search change, or show the outside-filters line in a slot that does not suppress the list. Add a pin that reopens the popover after the rejection and selects a listed candidate.

### ② Semver level

- **`Clause-②: yes (widening)`, on the PR body and the changeset, line-initial: right.** The published surface gains an optional `ActionParamDef.allowCreate` (`@object-ui/core`) and one key in the exported `RESOLVED_ONLY_PARAM_KEYS` value (`@object-ui/fields`). Nothing is removed, renamed or narrowed. The new string is additive. The claim's original `Clause-②: no` was correctly superseded by the amendment 7124599739.
- **`Metadata-protocol: none`: right.** An author can write nothing new: `allowCreate` was already declared on `FieldSchema` and is still refused on `ActionParamSchema`. Honouring the field's declared `allowCreate` and `lookupFilters` on one more path enforces their existing meaning and does not change it.
- **`patch` on every named package: right.** AGENTS.md (changeset rule 3): a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch`, and `none` takes `patch`. Repo practice agrees: 137 of the 184 `Clause-②: yes (widening)` changesets on `main` are patch-only, including several that touch `@object-ui/core` or `types`. The packages are in the `fixed` group, so the release bumps together regardless.
- **Package list against the diff.** `@object-ui/core` (ActionRunner.ts), `@object-ui/fields` (resolver, LookupField, useFieldTranslation), `@object-ui/plugin-grid` (resolveBulkActions.ts) and `@object-ui/i18n` (11 packs) are each named, and each is right. `@object-ui/types` is touched only by `src/__tests__/page-nav-misc-spec-parity.test.ts`, and the package publishes `files: ['dist', …]`, so leaving it unnamed is right.

**S2 (should-fix) — the changeset names `@object-ui/console` in place of `@object-ui/app-shell`, and the declared reason does not hold in this repo.** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.ts` is changed. The dev's deviation 2 says app-shell is private. It is (`"private": true`), but `.changeset/config.json` sets `privatePackages: { "version": true }`, app-shell keeps a versioned CHANGELOG (latest `18.5.0`), and the repo names it directly: 201 changesets on `main` name `@object-ui/app-shell`. Every recent app-shell change sampled names it (#36816, #36807, #36860, #36692, #36838, #36504, #36831, #36463, #36395, #36447, #36538 …), and when console appears it is beside app-shell (#36463, #36216, #35050), not in its place. As written, app-shell's CHANGELOG will not carry the record-header fix, and console's carries a change made outside it. The semver level is not affected, because console is in the `fixed` group. Fix: add `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`. Keeping console beside it is harmless.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions` in the done report 7127125322: `[]`.** The two round-1 questions (7124565256: widen to `ActionRunner.ts` and `resolveBulkActions.ts`, and add the told-why string) were answered by the seat's route call in amendment 7124599739 (A and A, size `S`, a route and not a maintainer ruling). The tree follows that route file for file: core member, toBulkParam carry, `RESOLVED_ONLY_PARAM_KEYS`, the optional parity pin, 11 packs and the `FIELD_DEFAULTS` row. Nothing is open.
- **Deviation 1 (PR body line order), deviation 5 (footer form) and deviation 4 (verify-lock hold times):** operational, with no effect on the contract. `PR-body guards` passed. Accepted.
- **Deviation 2 (console named because app-shell is private):** rejected. See S2.
- **Deviation 3 (browser reach NOT MEASURED):** accepted at size S. The three pin files drive the real chain on both faces: `resolveActionParam` to `paramToField` to `LookupField`, and `resolvePromotedBulkParams` to `bulkParamToField` to `LookupField`, at 1280 px and 390 px. They have controls and per-hop ablations (A–D in the body). CI `Test UI` 16/16 is green on the head.
- **Out-of-scope finding (Retry does not clear `createError`, called "pre-existing slot behaviour"):** escalated to S1. The premise "stays until the next create attempt" is wrong on this head, because the create entry is hidden while the error shows. This PR is what makes the slot routine.
- **Round-1 out-of-scope finding (parity pin tenth row):** taken in the diff. Closed.
- **S3 (should-fix) — the spec's bulk-param refusal prescription is now false for `allowCreate`. The dev did not flag this, and the fence does not allow it to be fixed in this PR.** `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts`, `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` (which lists `allowCreate`). Its `guidanceSets` prescription, emitted at parse time to an author who writes one of these keys on an authored bulk param, says a field's key reaches the dialog only through a promoted action, "⛔ So of these keys only `accept` / `maxSize` and those four picker settings arrive that way, and the rest are never read off the field. Remove the key, or for one of those six move the param onto a promoted action". The module jsdoc above it says the same: "From THIS list only those four and `accept` / `maxSize` make the trip … a confidently wrong answer for every other key here". After this PR, `toBulkParam` carries `allowCreate` from the field on a promoted def, so the prescription tells an author asking for `allowCreate: false` that the working route does not exist and that they should remove the key. `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` (row `list.bulkActionDefs`) also lists the carried picker settings as four, which is now incomplete. The claim fences out `packages/spec/**`, and a spec edit would move this PR to another review face, so the right home is a follow-up card. It should make the prescription, the jsdoc and the ledger note list `allowCreate` with the four (seven keys arrive), and re-verify the read points. The seat should file that card before or with the merge.
- **SQL push-down (Prime Directive 5), every face.** Half 1 adds no query. Half 2's re-read is one server `find` on `referenceTo`, with `$filter: ['and', popoverFilter-node, { [idField]: rid }]` and `$top: 1`. The filter and the id go down together to the REST and ObjectQL path, which runs it as a single filtered query. Admission is decided only by whether the server returned a row (a non-empty `rows`). No row set is fetched and filtered in the client, no id list is materialised, and nothing is joined in the app. The read is skipped outright when there is no filter. It passes.
- **N1 (nit) — failed re-read.** The `catch` arm is correct (fail-closed), but the user sees only the raw error. They are not told the record was created, so a retry can create a duplicate. No pin covers the arm: reading the rows, an ablation that set `admitted = true` in the `catch` would pass all five rows (not run) of `LookupField.quickCreateFilters-36865.test.tsx`. The PR body declares this behaviour, so a sixth row (`find` rejects ⇒ `onChange` not called) would make the declaration true.
- **N2 (nit) — small edges in `admitCreated`.**
  - The guard tests `!dataSource` rather than the component's own `hasDataSource` (`typeof dataSource.find === 'function'`). On a modal host whose data source has no `find`, a filtered picker would fail closed with a TypeError message instead of selecting.
  - `rid` comes from `recordValue`, which falls back to `id`, `_id` and `externalId`, while the filter keys on `idField`. A non-default `idField` that is missing from the created row would reject a valid record. This matches the recents rail's existing assumption.
  - The existence check fetches the whole row. A `$select` of `idField` would be enough.

Grades: three should-fix (S1, S2, S3) and two nits (N1, N2). No finding reaches the FAIL grade. S1 and S2 are small edits on this branch. S3 needs a follow-up card on `packages/spec`.

## 席位核对 — REWORK · repo:objectstack#3 · head e3be5dbb · 2026-11-24T09:25Z

L1-a read of #36919 (card #36865, p1) at `e3be5dbbfd39bbeb5da82b0d74e126a642479082`.

**Mechanical.**
- `l1-face`: 12 of 13 ok. All-checks: 45 success, 13 expected skips, 0 failed, 0 pending.
- The one flag, `changeset`, names `@object-ui/types`. Its only touched file is `src/__tests__/page-nav-misc-spec-parity.test.ts`, the package ships `files: ["dist", …]` and its `tsconfig` excludes `**/__tests__/**`, so it owes no entry.
- `check-governed-merges`: NOT governed, 479 lines. The card has one PR, so it is not Tier H.
- Contract review (TIER_DEFAULT, declaration face): claim 7127169888, record 7127384605 **PASS**, with three should-fixes open on this head.

**Read.** Half 1 is right: `lookupExtras` copies `field.allowCreate`, `RESOLVED_ONLY_PARAM_KEYS` names it, `paramToField` and `toBulkParam` forward it, and `ActionParamDef.allowCreate?` is an optional widening. Half 2 is right in shape. `admitCreated` re-reads the new id through `popoverFilter`, the same filter the list sends: no search term, lookupFilters plus the `dependsOn` scope, joined with `mergeFilterNodes`. It is one server `find` with `$top: 1`, so the filtering happens on the server. It skips the read when there is no filter, and it fails closed. Both create arms run through it.

**Findings (from the contract review, each verified in the tree):**
- **S1 (should-fix): after a rejected quick-create, the picker is stuck on the error line.** `error = popoverQuery.error ?? createError` (`LookupField.tsx:900`). The list, the empty-list create entry and the pinned footer all render only under `!error` (`:2085`, `:2149`, `:2157`). `setCreateError(null)` runs only at the top of `handleCreateNew` (`:1666`), which is reachable only from the create button the error hides. Retry calls `popoverQuery.refetch()`, and closing the popover clears nothing. So the card's own scenario leaves the popover and the phone drawer showing only `lookup.createdOutsideFilters` until the widget remounts. **Fix:** clear `createError` when the popover closes, on Retry and on a search change, or show the outside-filters line in a slot that doesn't hide the list. Add a pin that reopens after the rejection and selects a listed candidate.
- **S2 (should-fix): the changeset names `@object-ui/console` in place of `@object-ui/app-shell`.** `paramToField.ts` is app-shell's. `.changeset/config.json` versions private packages, app-shell keeps its own CHANGELOG, and recent changesets name it directly; when they name console, it sits beside app-shell (#36463, #36216, #35050). **Fix:** add `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`. Keeping console beside it does no harm.
- **S3 (should-fix, not on this branch; the seat files the card): the spec's bulk-param prescription is now wrong about `allowCreate`.** `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts` (`BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` guidance and jsdoc) says only `accept` / `maxSize` and four picker settings reach the dialog from the field, and tells an author to remove `allowCreate`. After this PR, `toBulkParam` carries it on a promoted def. `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` row `list.bulkActionDefs` has the same incomplete list. The claim fences `packages/spec/**` out, so a follow-up card owns this. It does not hold this PR, but the card needs to exist before landing.

**Nits (no action required):**
- N1. When the re-read fails, the catch arm sets the raw error. It doesn't say the record was created, so a retry can create a duplicate, and no pin covers the arm. A sixth row (`find` rejects ⇒ `onChange` not called) would make the body's claim pinned.
- N2. The guard checks `!dataSource` and not `typeof find === 'function'`. `rid` falls back through `id` / `_id` while the filter keys on `idField`. The re-read has no `$select`.

Two should-fixes are on this head (S1, S2), and S3 needs a card, so REWORK. The delta is a code change for S1 with its pin, plus the changeset line. The contract review takes a delta round on the new head, and L1 re-reads the face.
